title: Thai Coconut Scones
description: A sweet and savory twist on traditional British scones, inspired by the flavors of Thailand. These scones are perfect for a breakfast or snack.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and yeast.
Add the salt and whisk to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut milk, melted butter, khus essence, and khus syrup.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5-7 minutes, until the dough is smooth and elastic.
Pat the dough into a circle that is about 1 inch thick.
Use a biscuit cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out scones.
Place the scones on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the scones with a little extra melted butter.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the scones are golden brown.
Remove the scones from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes before serving.
